plan_requirements.facts: Map of engine rule fact names to true, false or null, with separate evidence/provenance records. Null means unknown, never false.
plan_requirements.binding: Every component reference is exactly {id,version,sha256}. Every source/model/design input retains its own artifact binding; component refs do not substitute for artifact refs.
plan_requirements.graph: Directed acyclic graph, including explicit assessment tasks for unknown material facts and independent review dependencies. No fixed financial method sequence.
plan_requirements.capability_truth: Every node capability must be supplied by its bound skill components and actual environment. Persona and runtime references must resolve but do not add skill capabilities.
plan_requirements.wire_schema: Installed schemas/plan.schema.json is authoritative: expert is a persona ref; skills is an array of skill refs; runtime is a runtime ref; reasoning is requested effort. Conceptual requirements here are not alternative field names.

decisions.rule: Use the requested purpose and decision; non-valuation domains currently yield planning-only artifacts.
Inspect originals and current access before promising a conclusion; source acquisition may precede final method choice.
Apply domain plan-rules to supported profile facts, then justify suitable methods and credible rejected alternatives.
Split by independent inputs, outputs, failure owner or review boundary; keep tightly coupled mechanical work together.
Assign one accountable producer per node. Reviewer must be an actual separate native agent with no authorship of reviewed artifacts.
New evidence may revise analysis and graph through a versioned plan; criteria additions, removals, thresholds and waivers require explicit human approval.

invariants: Fresh cutoff and fresh source snapshots for every report attempt; cache reuse requires new manifest and verified eligibility.
No protected evaluation access or answers in candidate library content.
Development cases are examples, not evaluation scores or release evidence.
A successful deterministic validator is structural evidence only.
Unresolved material findings cannot be closed by the artifact author.
No exporter or document builder upgrades a conditional analysis into professional assurance.
